task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the key condition matches the “also take the key” requirement, and the hard Existence(target_picked_up), Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up), and Response(blocker_moved, target_picked_up) capture the required final pickup and its ordering.

texts: If the ball is moved, the matching key must also be acquired at some point.
Pick up the box in the other room.
Acquire the matching key before picking up the box.
If the ball is moved, pick up the box afterward.
